I think Seanchan will have an interesting dynamic going with Shara should the series ever continue.

Shara lacks leadership after Graendals manipulation and Damandreds corruption, their channelers are treated terribly and seem to take eagerly to the A'dam. As was noted by Suian, their society doesn't have any mechanism for redemption. Every infraction earns you tattoos that must be shown at all times, seemed like a very strange way of doing things to me.

Seanchan is pretty terrible if you look at the culture of assassination and slavery but Shara seems worse. They need Tuon and Mat to consolidate their two empires.
